test_title: PYST 10: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

The teacher was accused of **__brazen__** favouritism in assigning the grades.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Unashamed."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Brazen"** means shameless or unashamed. (निर्लज्ज, बेशर्म, लज्जाहीन)

 
 
• **Example**: *Don’t believe a word she says—she’s a **brazen**__ liar!*
 
 
 
• The word is used to describe the teacher's favouritism in assigning grades.
 
• Synonyms of **brazen** is Unashamed.
 
• "Unshamed" means not feeling sorry or embarrassed about something bad that you have done. (निर्लज्ज, बेहया (जिसे अपने बुरे काम पर न खेद हो न लज्‍जा))
 __
 
• **Example**: *Afterwards he spent five minutes with the president, of whom he is an **unashamed**__ admirer.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (Modest) **means humble or unassuming. (विनम्र, विनीत (अपनी क्षमताओं आदि का बखान न करने वाला))
 
• **Option 2 (Shy)** means timid or bashful. (लोगों से मिलने और बात करने में घबराहट और बेचैनी अनुभव करने वाला; संकोची, शरमीला, झेंपू; संकोच दिखाने वाला)
 
• **Option 4 (Ashamed)** means embarrassed or guilty. (लज्जित, शर्मिंदा)
